listing.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky (OpenXRay)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official support includes Call of Pripyat and finishable Clear Sky; Windows nightly packages. Limits: Call of Pripyat and finishable Clear Sky current; Shadow of Chernobyl and Enhanced Edition unsupported. Upstream platforms: Windows nightly packages; Linux/macOS/BSD source routes. README documents ARM/ARM64/PPC64LE/E2K portability but selected Windows artifact CPUs unknown in frozen evidence. Original data: Shadow of Chernobyl and Enhanced Edition NOT supported. Mutable nightly tag needs asset identity handling. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
